defect: vector stream data is selected with logical operators
rationale: The logical && and || operators collapse the selected eight-bit data path to a Boolean result instead of preserving the data bits through bitwise gating and selection.

mutation.description: Replaced the vector bitwise selection operators with logical && and || operators.

author: gpt-5.6-luna

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the stream multiplexer to two eight-bit data inputs and one select input.

labels.note: logical && / || on 8-bit data collapses to 1 bit instead of bitwise mux
